item.title: Former Crown Event Center site in downtown Fayetteville sits vacant as Cumberland County weighs next steps
item.description: Cumberland County leaders scrapped plans for the Crown Event Center last year, leaving the site, just steps from the Cumberland County Courthouse, vacant for the past eight months.
